authority: CONTROLLED REGRESSION REFERENCE — NOT A UNIVERSAL DEVICE PERFORMANCE CLAIM
aggregation: Frame session values are medians of per-iteration percentiles; hot-resume TTID session values are medians of raw iterations. Authority values are medians of three session medians.

songs.definition: Cached settled Songs at top; six normalized 78%-to-31% downward swipes; verify first unique path leaves viewport and Songs remains visible.
songs.cache_state: Cached database; newly launched process; refresh settled.

albums.definition: Cold app artwork cache; navigate to Albums outside measurement; six normalized downward swipes; verify first album leaves viewport and later fixture albums remain.
albums.cache_state: LibrePlayer in-memory artwork cache cold per iteration; OS/file caches unspecified.

search.definition: Blank loaded Search; progressively set D, Du, Dup, Dupl, Duplicate; verify Duplicate Display Metadata after every state.
search.cache_state: Loaded stable library; blank query at iteration start.
search.correctness: 225/225 reference and 225/225 development query-state validations passed across the closeout sessions.
search.classification_reason: No frame percentile is stable in both reference and development channels; the interaction intrinsically captures only about 8-16 target frames per iteration. UIAutomator cannot define a sufficiently precise result-visible latency boundary without production instrumentation.

resume.definition: Usable cached Songs with resident process; press Home; normal launch return; verify known Songs content and absence of blank scanning state.
resume.cache_state: StartupMode.HOT; process and Activity remain resident; not cold or warm startup.
resume.correctness: 60/60 reference and 60/60 development cached-content returns passed across the closeout sessions.

timeToInitialDisplayMs.semantic_start: system receives the normal launcher intent for the resident Activity
timeToInitialDisplayMs.semantic_end: first frame of the destination Activity is displayed

resume.classification_reason: Official AndroidX hot-start TTID exactly matches the resident Home-to-foreground transition and is below the approximately 10% session-noise warning in both channels. FrameTimingMetric is underpowered and diagnostic only.

measurement_quality_notes: Songs/Albums include hundreds of target frames per iteration and show approximate reference/development equivalence; several session ranges exceed the approximately 10% emulator-noise diagnostic.
The 15-iteration Search closeout captures roughly 8-16 target frames per iteration, but no percentile is stable across both channels; all Search frame values are diagnostic only.
The 20-iteration resident foreground closeout establishes limited numeric authority for official hot-start TTID; reference and development session ranges are 8.19% and 8.41% respectively.
Resume FrameTimingMetric captures zero or one target frame per iteration and is diagnostic only; empty frame runs do not invalidate populated TTID or cached-content correctness.
No controlled Search latency was accepted because UIAutomator observation would not provide a sufficiently precise boundary without production instrumentation.
One original five-iteration Search selector failure remains preserved separately; all 450 closeout query-state checks passed.
Raw AndroidX JSON, per-iteration values, extrema, metadata, and Perfetto traces remain in ignored generated results.
